description:
Being single for 20 years is hard for a man, especially when he has an adult daughter. Doctor Hun has outdated views toward love, relationships, and sex before marriage. At the same time, his grown-up daughter and people enjoy all those life aspects.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=170026), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/for_fathers_s), [Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/1323), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=do69)
